args: Go to http://127.0.0.1:4790/login. Sign in with username {{amber_user}} and password {{amber_password}} with Stay logged in ticked, then verify the home page greets Amber Demo. In the main menu, mark the project Reading list as a favorite with the star next to it, then verify Reading list is shown as a favorite. Reload the page, then verify Reading list is still shown as a favorite.
